question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Essential**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Essential **means necessary or crucial. (आवश्यक या निर्णायक)

 
 
• **Example**: *Regular exercise and a balanced diet are essential for maintaining good health.*
 
 
 
• The use of "essential" suggests that this upgrading is not just beneficial but fundamentally necessary for achieving the desired improvement in global standing.
 
• It emphasizes the critical role that advancements in the higher education sector play in contributing to India's competitiveness and recognition on the global stage.
 
• So, it is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Unrequired **means not needed or unnecessary. (आवश्यक नहीं या अनावश्यक)
 
• **Deserving **means worthy of something. (किसी चीज के योग्य)
 
• **Fulfilling **means satisfying or completing. (संतुष्ट करने वाला या पूरा करने वाला)
